description: Search one mailbox, or all of them with account="all", using Gmail search syntax. Returns id, thread id, date, from, to, subject and snippet — use read_email for the full body. An empty query lists the newest mail.

account.description: Email, alias, or "all" to search every connected mailbox.

max_results.description: How many messages to return (1–100). With account="all", the newest across all mailboxes.

page_token.description: nextPageToken from a previous call (single account only).

name: search_emails
title: Search mail
